if(NOT TARGET hc32_app_log_headers)
    add_library(hc32_app_log_headers INTERFACE)
    add_library(hc32::app_log_headers ALIAS hc32_app_log_headers)
    target_include_directories(hc32_app_log_headers INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
    target_link_libraries(hc32_app_log_headers INTERFACE app::log_headers)
endif()
file(GLOB APP_PLATFORM_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS *.cpp)
list(FILTER APP_PLATFORM_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "AppLogDisabled[.]cpp$")
if((NOT HC32_PORTABLE AND NOT HC32_LOG_ENABLED) OR HC32_BUILD_LOG_TESTS)
    if(NOT TARGET hc32_app_log_disabled)
        add_library(hc32_app_log_disabled OBJECT AppLogDisabled.cpp)
        add_library(hc32::app_log_disabled ALIAS hc32_app_log_disabled)
        target_link_libraries(hc32_app_log_disabled PUBLIC proj::options hc32::app_log_headers)
    endif()
endif()
if(NOT HC32_PORTABLE AND NOT HC32_LOG_ENABLED)
    set_property(TARGET app_log PROPERTY SOURCES $<TARGET_OBJECTS:hc32::app_log_disabled>)
    target_compile_options(app_log PUBLIC
        -include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/AppLogDisabled.h)
endif()
add_library(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}app_platform OBJECT ${APP_PLATFORM_SOURCES})
add_library(hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}app_platform ALIAS hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}app_platform)
target_include_directories(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}app_platform PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}app_platform PUBLIC
    ${HC32_PORT} app::ui hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}state hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}gpio_headers)
